note: audit reproduction of a POST-HOC check; inference with frozen weights only; not an endpoint

definitions.top_touch_dilated16: original: the highest-confidence box (the one that set the image score) shares at least one pixel with the GT mask grown by 16 px (33x33 max filter); no IoU
definitions.top_center_in_dilated_mask: centre of the top box lies inside the dilated mask
definitions.top_iou_ge_t: IoU of the top box with the best-matching GT component box (the training boxes) >= t
definitions.any_above_iou_ge_0.5: at least one box above the fold threshold has IoU >= 0.5 with a GT component box
